events.description:
Cloud Native Linz
We are excited to host the May 2026 edition of the Cloud Native Linz meetup!
We'd like to thank [Dynatrace](https://www.dynatrace.com/) for hosting the Meetup!

###

**More Information**
Find more information also on [cloudnativelinz.at](https://cloudnativelinz.at)!

Here's what to expect at our meetups.
17:30 Doors open
18:00 Opening by organizers
18:10 First speaker (talk + Q&A)
18:45 Break & networking
19:00 Second speaker (talk + Q&A)
19:45 Extended networking, raffle & discussions
